title: ModularPhaseNet: Finite-Cyclic Phase Geometry for Computable Semantic Hierarchy, Direction, and Context Consistency in Standard Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2609.06000v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose ModularPhaseNet, a classical and integer-computable discretization of the continuous complex phase geometry introduced in QuantumPhaseNet. The real-valued hidden states of a standard Transformer are retained, while only an auxiliary phase channel is quantized into a cyclic subgroup G =  of order q | (p-1) in the multiplicative group of F_p. translated_title: ModularPhaseNet：面向标准Transformer中可计算语义层次、方向与上下文一致性的有限循环相位几何
translated_abstract: 我们提出ModularPhaseNet，这是对QuantumPhaseNet中引入的连续复相位几何的一种经典且可整数计算的离散化方法。该方法保留标准Transformer的实值隐藏状态，仅将一个辅助相位通道量化为F_p乘法群中阶为q | (p-1)的循环子群G = <g>。连续相位 e^{iφ} 由 z = g^a mod p 表示；相位复合对应群乘法，相对相位对应群除法，概念层次由循环商群的滤过（filtration）诱导，语义方向由有向的相对群元素表示，而上下文一致性则通过规范不变的循环和乐（holonomy）来度量。该方法在原本标准的Transformer中引入三个组件：有限相位编码器、商群滤过层次模块和群值联络模块，它们的输出以实值形式进入自注意力机制。
tldr: ModularPhaseNet通过将辅助相位通道离散化为有限循环群并以纯经典整数运算实现，使标准Transformer获得可计算的语义层次结构、语义方向表示和上下文一致性度量能力。
en_tdlr: ModularPhaseNet discretizes an auxiliary phase channel into a finite cyclic group, enabling standard Transformers to achieve computable semantic hierarchy, semantic direction, and context consistency through purely classical integer computation.
